title: Loss watch
summary: Admins only: discounts, voids, refunds and estimated comps by day and by employee, and the checks that stand out.

blocks.text: Loss watch shows discounts, voids, refunds and estimated comps by day and by employee, built from {pos}'s check report each night at 4:30 AM. Checks that stand out are flagged:

items: well above that employee's usual (3 times their 30-day median),
a large discount (over $50), void (over $50) or refund (over $25),

blocks.text: When something is flagged, admins get one combined alert at 9 AM the next day (held during quiet hours). **Acknowledge** marks a flagged check as looked at.
A flag is a prompt to look, not proof of a problem. Look the check up in {pos} before talking to anyone.
